claims: Submitting Form 4868 by April 15 grants until October 15 to file a federal tax extension.
A tax extension to file does not extend time to pay taxes owed.
IRS Free File allows electronic submission of Form 4868 for free regardless of income.
Selecting "4868" or "Extension" when making a partial or full payment via IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or Digital Wallet automatically triggers an extension without filing Form 4868 separately.
Tax software such as TurboTax or H&R Block or a tax professional can be used to e-file Form 4868.
A paper Form 4868 filed by mail must be postmarked by April 15.
A tax extension request must be submitted by April 15.
If taxes are owed, the estimated amount due must be paid by April 15 to avoid penalties and interest.
Anyone can file a tax extension regardless of income.
E-filing provides a confirmation number for records.
A federal tax extension does not always cover state taxes.
